title: An 8-foot Bigfoot was spotted in Connecticut last month. It’s far from New England’s first.
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Kevin Klimas reported a Bigfoot sighting in Voluntown, Connecticut on July 5, describing the creature as eight feet tall.
The Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization has verified 126 sightings in New England since 1994, including 3 in New London County.
Experts like Boston University's Eva Garrett argue there is no scientific evidence supporting Bigfoot's existence, citing new primate discoveries.

title: I will miss my friend Margo, who told me to grieve, but not too much
author: Meredith Goldstein
bullets: Margo Howard, daughter of Ann Landers, was a noted advice columnist who passed away at age 86.
Howard wrote for both Slate's 'Dear Prudence' and The Boston Globe's 'Dear Margo' columns.
Her friend Meredith Goldstein recalls Howard's advice on navigating grief while finding future happiness.

title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Payton Tolle struck out 14 batters, allowing two hits in six innings, as Red Sox defeated Athletics 13-1.
The Red Sox offense accumulated 15 hits, highlighted by a five-run second inning, extending their winning streak to nine games.
Ceddanne Rafaela's diving catch helped preserve Tolle's perfect game into the fifth inning as the Red Sox improved to 64-51.

title: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez continue sharpening each other’s games at Patriots training camp
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez are intensely competing in Patriots training camp, improving each other's skills.
Gonzalez uses strategic trash talk against Brown to simulate real-game conditions he will face this season.
Gonzalez seeks a new contract while preparing for a challenging schedule of top NFL receivers in 2026.

title: New Red Sox catcher Adley Rutschman to begin rehab assignment this weekend
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Adley Rutschman, acquired by the Red Sox from the Orioles, will begin a rehab assignment with Triple-A Worcester on Saturday.
Rutschman was placed on the 10-day injured list by the Orioles on July 20 due to left wrist inflammation.
Rutschman, a three-time All-Star with a .764 OPS, adds depth to the Red Sox as they hold a wild-card spot.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' streams on Paramount+, featuring Aang facing a balance-shifting ancient warrior.
'You, Me & Tuscany' starring Halle Bailey and Regé-Jean Page is now available on Peacock.
'Ted Lasso' Season 4, with Jason Sudeikis, debuts on Apple TV, focusing on a women's team at AFC Richmond.

title: Could Garrett Crochet return to Red Sox in a bullpen role?
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Garrett Crochet has not pitched for the Red Sox since April due to shoulder inflammation and a lat strain.
Interim manager Chad Tracy suggests it's unlikely Crochet will return as a starter, but may contribute from the bullpen.
Crochet is open to returning as a reliever, and his presence could boost the bullpen during a strong Red Sox season.

title: Lost a python? Boston Animal Care and Control might have it.
author: Heather Alterisio
bullets: A ball python named 'Tippy' was found Wednesday near Ellington Street in Dorchester.
Boston Animal Care and Control retrieved the python after residents saw it left in a cage.
Officials urge those with information about the snake to contact Boston Animal Care and Control.

title: Tommy DeVito bests Drake Maye, and other takeaways from Patriots’ training camp scrimmage
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Tommy DeVito led Team Blue to a 22-15 scrimmage victory over Drake Maye's Team White at Patriots training camp.
DeMario Douglas impressed with six catches and two touchdowns, including a 50-yard play, during Friday's practice session.
Injury updates include Carlton Davis likely out until next week and Brenden Schooler remaining cautious on his return.

title: A closer look at Harwich, voted the best town on Cape Cod by Boston.com readers
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Harwich was voted the best town on Cape Cod by 850 Boston.com readers in an informal poll.
The town features nearly 11 miles of tidal shoreline along Nantucket Sound and Pleasant Bay.
Harwich offers cultural, historical sites, and over 20 beaches, appealing to all ages and interests.
